hero.source: Sebara Dildiy (Broken Bridge) on Blue Nile River
hero.description: One of only two stone bridges built over the Blue Nile during the reign of Emperor Fasilides in approximately 1660.  Destroyed during World War II by retreating Italian soldiers.
